situation: A configured repo is run a second time. The board has not changed. The clock has.
expected_guard: zero bytes written, `git diff --stat` empty, and the stamp NOT refreshed
must_not: report `REGION-PRESENT` — that outcome is retired, and a run emitting it is running the old skill
refresh the timestamp — re-stamping is not a change, and writing one costs the zero-bytes guarantee
present a restamp as a change in the report
render `unchanged` when the probe could not be read — those are the two most different answers this step can give
report_lines_why: DRIFT runs on a refresh as well as a placement: the hand-written prose can drift while the region is current, and that is the common case. The earlier justification — 'stops at CLASSIFY, before DRIFT runs' — died with the stop it referred to
